<b>Roach Guts</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
10 Roach Guts are required to complete the <i>[[Roach Guts (Wish)|Roach Guts]]</i> Wish, given out by [[Crull and Benjin]] in [[Sinner's Road]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Crull and Benjin 01.png!Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sinner's Road 05.png!Crull and Benjin in Sinner's Road
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Roach Guts are obtained from the corpses of slain [[Muckroach]]es.

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can carry up to 10 Roach Guts, after which they will no longer drop from defeated Muckroaches.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Muckroach 01.png!Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Muckroach 07.png!Roach Guts inside Muckroach in Sinner's Road
}}

==Act 3==
All Roach Guts will be removed from the inventory at the start of Act 3, as [[Crull and Benjin]] have died.
